definition.title: Effective lung compartment for contract verification

validity.description: Deterministic two-second transit selected solely to verify component contracts.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M3 body-organ coupling contract tests, version 1.0.0

limitations: The two-second transit is a test value and is not physiological evidence.
The model has no anatomy, pressure, resistance, perfusion distribution, uncertainty, or gas exchange.
